body:
From a failed build step, one action creates a task for an agent to fix it.

- A **File a task** button on the failure summary in the Build tab. It opens a prefilled new-task form the human can edit before creating: the title `build: <project> <step> fails`, the body with the failure summary, the command and a link to the build, and the scope set to the failing project.
- The step's log is attached in full to the task as a note, so the agent reads it without the page.
- The build shows a link to the task, and the task links back to the build.
- A second press on the same failure opens the existing task instead of creating another.

Once the Delivery project exists, widen the scope to include it (D-127).

**Tests:** the API creates the task with the right scope, note and links. A second request returns the existing task. A view test covers the button and the link.
title: build: file a task from a failure
